thread:
sara: Quick heads-upI opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2 language around retention, export metadata, and to add compact Node/Python SDK snippets. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980
docs-bot: PR opened by sara 024h labels: docs, compliance
jon: skimmed. Two tiny wording asks: 1) Replace 'PII' with 'sensitive customer data (SCD)' and add a short parenthetical definition. 2) Add an explicit line: 'Exports are snapshots and do not modify retention TTLs or legal hold state.'
amy: legal ok on the SCD shorthand. Suggest exact sentence for the docs: "Sensitive customer data (SCD): customer-provided identifiers or content the customer considers confidential." Also require that exports for legal requests include `authorization_url` and `authorized_by` metadata.
sara: added SCD definition and included `authorization_url` in the examples. Also added a small FAQ: 'Do exports change retention?' -> 'No, they do not.'
devops: infra note: backend currently recognizes `scrub_keys` and `consent_url`. If docs show `redaction_fields` we should map to `scrub_keys` in the HTTP example. We have INF-6142 to accept `authorization_url`; ETA ~5 days.
sara: ok I'll surface the server canonical names in the JSON example and keep SDK snippets using SDK param names with a short alias note. Marking the PR Draft until INF-6142 is tracked.
sdk-bot: Suggested snippet updates: Node: `client.exports.create({scrub_keys: ['email']})` and Python: `client.exports.create(scrub_keys=['email'])`. Add inline comment: "# server-side authorization support pending (INF-6142)"
jon: one more: add a small manifest example showing `redaction_status` values (queued/processing/done/failed) so customers know to check artifact metadata.
amy: approved subject to adding the required `authorized_by` metadata and the authorization acceptance path note: "Submit authorization via support attaching the signed document or provide counsel review link."
sara: thanks all. PR set to Draft and updated with an "Implementation status" banner pointing to INF-6142. Will request full review once infra ticket is linked. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980 (Draft)
docs-bot: sara updated PR #980 024h labels: draft, compliance
